reader.requirement: At --std 85 the plain CONTINUE statement must be accepted, as a no-operation, in every position where a conditional or imperative statement may be written (a sentence, IF/ELSE branches, nested IF, EVALUATE WHEN and WHEN OTHER, inline PERFORM, SEARCH AT END and WHEN, the SIZE ERROR, OVERFLOW and AT END phrases, a paragraph holding only CONTINUE, before another statement); the 2023 CONTINUE AFTER ... SECONDS form does not exist in 1985 and must be refused.

edition-consulted.switches: Constructs.ContinueAfter2023: the AFTER ... SECONDS phrase is refused below 2023 (COBOL0900); plain CONTINUE is ungated

reader.edition-search: continueStatement is one alternative of the shared statement rule (CobolParserCore.g4), so it is reached wherever any imperative statement is; BindContinue returns BoundNop for plain CONTINUE with no edition test; the only edition consult is the phrase gate.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: CONTINUE AFTER arithmetic-expression SECONDS is accepted at 2023 and refused at 85; plain CONTINUE is the same at every edition
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witness uses CONTINUE in a debugging declarative procedure; not exercised: the conditional-statement phrases (SIZE ERROR, OVERFLOW, AT END, SEARCH WHEN), EVALUATE, inline PERFORM, the AFTER phrase refusal

probes.printed: IF-OK / AFTER-CONT 001 ABCD (no BAD lines; exit 0)
probes.expected: CONTINUE accepted in sentence, IF/ELSE, nested IF, EVALUATE WHEN/OTHER, inline PERFORM, SEARCH AT END/WHEN, ADD ON SIZE ERROR (N1 stays 001), STRING ON OVERFLOW (S1 = ABCD), READ AT END of an empty sequential file, a paragraph of only CONTINUE, CONTINUE before DISPLAY; no effect on execution

probes.printed: error COBOL0900: CONTINUE AFTER n SECONDS requires COBOL-2023 (targeting COBOL-85)
probes.expected: refused: the 1985 general format is CONTINUE alone

reader.notes: CONTINUE is an alternative of the one statement rule, so every imperative-statement position admits it, and it binds to a no-op. Every position probed compiled and ran with no effect, and the 2023-only AFTER phrase is refused by name at --std 85.

refuter.evidence: q3ok.cob (run, --std 85, exit 0, prints 'R=XYZ' and 'DONE 002 AB 3'): CONTINUE accepted and inert as the only statement of a declarative USE AFTER STANDARD ERROR paragraph; in WRITE/READ/START/DELETE/REWRITE INVALID KEY and NOT INVALID KEY on an indexed file; in WRITE AT END-OF-PAGE and NOT AT END-OF-PAGE on a LINAGE file inside an inline PERFORM n TIMES; DIVIDE by zero ON SIZE ERROR (N1 kept, NOT ON SIZE ERROR not taken); ADD NOT ON SIZE ERROR; UNSTRING ON OVERFLOW (NOT ON OVERFLOW not taken); CALL ON OVERFLOW of a missing program; SEARCH ALL WHEN; EVALUATE ... ALSO ... WHEN ANY ALSO 0; inside inline PERFORM UNTIL after another statement; two consecutive CONTINUEs before ELSE NEXT SENTENCE; RETURN AT END and NOT AT END in a SORT output procedure. The 2023 AFTER phrase is refused at 85 (reader's r3ref). Two first-draft errors (UNSTRING of a literal, WRITE FROM literal COBOL0871) were correct 1985 refusals of my probe. cite.py: OK §1985:VI.6.9.3 SR1 [may be used anywhere a conditional statement or an imperative-statement may be used].
